name: Techno Smart Corp.
summary: Techno Smart Corp. was established in Osaka in 1912 and manufactures industrial equipment. Its machinery produces liquid crystal films, cast films and ceramic sheets, coats magnetic materials, fabricates batteries and thermally processes carbon fibers and ceramics. It also offers high-speed drying and odor elimination for printing and industrial deodorizers in direct-fired, catalytic and heat-storage types.
